target.timing_boundary: one per-request normalized sample from a fixed batch of 16 recent Conversation requests against the same fixed 125-session fixture, each request using its own current UTC upper bound and accepted through one indexed 20-row encrypted-session page and exact newest-first total order materialized
excluded_time: Store open, migration, 125-row fixture loading, and baseline I/O

approval.reason: The single source-owned release matrix observed a p50-only relative regression for the fixed-batch indexed recent-list target; p95 and p99 remained within the 10% relative limit, the absolute p95 budget remained Green, and read-only diagnosis found no N+1 query or table-scan regression.
approval.impact_scope: conversation_list_recent_batched_v2 p50 only, bound to the exact current source revision and capped at 136200ns; no p95, p99, absolute-budget, other-target, or later-source waiver
